redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_audit_task.py --selftest --stage at7-block` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 1 of 227 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (HEAD's own tests green on HEAD's code), each passing with the working tree's implementation - pab1 (house FAIL): SELFTEST FAILED: 225/227 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home)

outcome.technical: Added --parent-branch <name> to audit-task.py's add-phase and retarget verbs (parser flag, VERB_FLAGS entries, Usage docstring block), plus the batch file's phase.parentBranch key (BATCH_PHASE_KEYS, _batch_phase_problems) for /audit:phase add's --from-file path. A new _parent_branch_refusal(project, config, value) validates the name as an existing local branch via `git rev-parse --verify -q refs/heads/<name>` before any write, in _locked_phase_add, _locked_batch_add and _locked_retarget; _build_phase writes phase.parentBranch when given, and _journal_phase_add/_journal_retarget record it (details.parent for phase.add, the generic changes[] row for retarget). retarget refuses --parent-branch once phase.branch is already set, for the same reason --rename is refused there (message mirrors the rename refusal's wording). _phase_entry's 'forks from X, HEAD on Y' refusal (read by start) now names the remedy as `retarget <phaseId> --parent-branch <branch>` instead of the unactionable 'set the phase's parentBranch'. Updated commands/phase.md (argument-hint for add and retarget; the add subcommand's hint-flags-to-batch-keys mapping; trimmed an unrelated filler sentence from the run-a-phase section to keep the file's measured body under its 4000-byte ceiling, which tools/measure-context.py --gate confirms is unchanged at 3985/4000), plugins/audit/README.md's /audit:phase command-table row (both argument cells, to satisfy command_flag_drift / cf1), and reference/manifest-conventions.md's New phase template section (documents parentBranch as the third optional field, written through add-phase/retarget --parent-branch, never by hand). commands/task.md needed no change: its own `add` hint describes task-add's flags, which audit-task.py's task-add verb (not add-phase) still owns, and test__refs.py's tk2 check is unaffected. Added 7 new selftest cases (pab1-pab7) to test_audit_task.py's _record_cases slice (at7-block), covering: add-phase --parent-branch on a feature branch then start forking the phase branch from it with baseRef recorded (pab1-pab3); --parent-branch naming no local branch refused before any write (pab4); retarget --parent-branch refused like --rename once the phase has a branch, and accepted onto a branch-less phase (pab5-pab6); start's forks-from refusal naming --parent-branch (pab7). Verified: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_audit_task.py --selftest --stage at7-block` -> 231/231 cases passed; the whole file's selftest -> 1036/1036 cases passed (no duplicate case ids); `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --jobs 6` -> 333/334 files ok (the one failure, test__refs.py's pre-existing so3 case about evidence-ledger phase-scope rows, is unrelated to this task's files and was already red before this change touched anything); `python3 tools/measure-context.py --gate` -> GATE OK, /audit:phase run form unchanged at 3985/4000.
outcome.descriptive: add-phase, retarget and the phase-add batch can now set a phase's parentBranch to an existing local branch, start forks off it, and start's own refusal tells the operator which verb and flag fixes it.
